prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct camera/footprint of the Qing Jiangnan government courtyard in image 2 onto the exact stone-pad geometry of image 1. Keep historic realistic matte gray tile roofs, off-white walls, dark wooden lattice doors, modest red-brown columns and limited teal/ochre beam paint, rear main hall, side halls, front wall and main gate facing lower left, small plants. The original view is TOO STEEP and the compound TOO SQUARE. Lower camera elevation slightly and widen the long front frontage relative to depth to EXACT WORLD footprint17x13. Exact 2:1 orthographic dimetric: two ground axes have slopes +0.500 and -0.500. In1536x1024 canvas, mandatory outside floor corners LEFT=(168,590), FRONT=(848,930), RIGHT=(1368,670), BACK=(688,330). Keep these locations unchanged from guide. Width edge680px runs right/down340, depth edge520px runs right/up260. All walls, courtyard paving, eaves and sills parallel to these ground edges. Keep entire thin exposed stone rim and three outer ground corners visible; no wall or stairs beyond pad boundaries. Replace guide grid with fine worn stone pavers. Same detail density as image2; clean transparent-background ancient city game sprite, upper-left light and tiny lower-right contact shadow. Actual RGBA transparent outside, no colored glow. Full roof uncropped and safe clear margins. No modern objects, humans, writing, plaque text, logo, watermark. Do not rotate/skew the guide, no thick podium.
